sentences.en: There are about a hundred unidentified bodies to be buried.
sentences.zh: 大约有一百具身份不明的尸体等待埋葬。

sentences.en: We believed that the object was a UFO (Unidentified Flying Object).
sentences.zh: 我们相信那个物体是一架未确认飞行物（UFO）。

sentences.en: Instead of ink, there was some unidentified liquid in the bottle.
sentences.zh: 瓶子里装的不是墨水，而是一种未知液体。

senses.zh: 不能辨认的,来路身分不明的,未经确认的
